dreamteamer.title: Protocol
dreamteamer.description: The host protocol the dreamteamer UI speaks to whatever hosts it — the VS Code extension in-process, dt serve and dt web over HTTP: every method and path, its request and response shapes, the errors, the host-to-app notifications, the boot globals and the host capabilities, written once in PROTOCOL.md and pinned by a contract suite every host runs. A library module: it contributes no collection and no verb.
